functions.evidence: Returns 1u << map->page_shift, or 1u << 14 for a null map. Original loads byte +0x2c; native loads halfword +0x44 and obtains the native default shift from page_shift. Both implement osfmk/vm/vm_map.c vm_map_page_size / VM_MAP_PAGE_SIZE. Map is kernel-owned; bind the callable KPI, never rewrite a struct offset. Original neighbors include vm_map_exec and vm_map_region_top_walk. Source revision ac9718fb1af618d5ce8678d0dc6e8a58f252216f.

Computes a local stack address minus the active stack bottom. Interrupt stack bounds use top minus 0x4000; normal stack uses current_thread kernel_stack. The original CONFIG_SPTM path additionally subtracts a red-zone page when kredzonestack is zero. Native non-SPTM implementation omits that conditional, as required by its own kernel stacks. Matches osfmk/arm/machine_routines_common.c ml_stack_remaining, source revision ac9718fb1af618d5ce8678d0dc6e8a58f252216f. Same no-argument vm_offset_t ABI; this binding does not claim original/private struct layout compatibility.

void(void), noreturn. Native implements the same state machine with its own CPU data offsets. osfmk/arm64/cpu.c ml_arm_sleep, lines 1024 onward. Public source revision ac9718fb1af618d5ce8678d0dc6e8a58f252216f.

int(void): TPIDR_EL1 current_thread then zero-extended 16-bit machine.cpu_number; original +0x1b0, native +0x238 after current_thread(). Public source revision ac9718fb1af618d5ce8678d0dc6e8a58f252216f.

uint64_t(void): loads the exact 8-byte global written by the proven ml_arm_sleep boot-CPU path, original 0xfffffe000b9284f0, native 0xfffffff007fffd38. osfmk/arm/cpu_common.c:901 returns wake_abstime. Corroborated by producer and consumer, not merely a leaf load shape. Public source revision ac9718fb1af618d5ce8678d0dc6e8a58f252216f.

void(unsigned int die_id, unsigned int die_cluster_id): w0/w1 select topology cluster die_id and die_cluster_id; original cluster stride 0x58 vs native 0x50; loads its cpu_mask, acquires cluster_powerdown_lock and scheduler spinlock, ORs pcs_required_online_pmgr (+0x28), synchronously calls sched_update_powered_cores_drops_lock with REASON_PMGR_SYSTEM=5, flushes pulled thread queue and unlocks. osfmk/kern/sched_prim.c:7916. The topology and scheduler structures remain owned by the native implementation. Public source revision ac9718fb1af618d5ce8678d0dc6e8a58f252216f.

void(unsigned int die_id, unsigned int die_cluster_id): same w0/w1 topology lookup as enable, ANDs pcs_required_online_pmgr with complement cpu_mask under scheduler spinlock, records reason 5 and signals sched_update_powered_cores_wakeup/thread asynchronously. osfmk/kern/sched_prim.c:7964. This differs deliberately from synchronous enable and is not bound by function adjacency alone. Public source revision ac9718fb1af618d5ce8678d0dc6e8a58f252216f.

Writes refCount=1 at +8; signs vptr for __ZTV24IOCPUInterruptController+16 with address discriminator 0xcda1; increments __ZN24IOCPUInterruptController10gMetaClassE instanceCount at +0x24, traversing superClassLink on 0-to-1. The only selected importer is AppleARMWatchdogTimer GOT 0xfffffe0007f873b0, veneer 0xfffffe000871b0b4, BL 0xfffffe00087170e0. The whole caller fixes count=5 at 0xfffffe00087170ac and flavor=1 at 0xfffffe00087170dc, then consumes running at info+8. IOReturn(this=x0): kdebug_debugid_enabled(0x05410004), preparation ID >=2, nonzero descriptor ID, private reserved state present, then iterates getPhysicalSegment(offset,&length,0) until zero length or getLength; returns kIOReturnBadArgument 0xe00002c2 or success. void*(size_t*): original 16-byte wrapper calls txm_image4_storage_data, whose exact diagnostic is unsupported AppleImage4 interface (txm.c). This is the public storage API selected through the kernel wrapper, not a general missing function mapped to panic. Selected AppleImage4 caller 0xfffffe0009016fbc passes &size, checks size>=0x390 and pointer alignment 8, then initializes its own storage. Native kernel wrapper calls xnu_image4_storage_data, which returns a real zero-initialized 8-aligned 0x1400-byte buffer at __xnu_image4_storage and writes size_t 0x1400. Source bsd/kern/code_signing/{txm.c,xnu.c}; monitor-specific semantics are NOT claimed by this storage binding. Public source revision ac9718fb1af618d5ce8678d0dc6e8a58f252216f.

data.evidence: 8-byte aligned function-pointer slot, not code. Original RELEASE const slot is initially NULL; Watchdog reads 8 bytes and installs a callback with OSCompareAndSwapPtr, signing callback with discriminator 0x2abe. AppleProcessorTrace imports the same slot. Native PE_panic_hook loads this exact native symbol and BRAA-authenticates with the same 0x2abe. pexpert/pexpert/pexpert.h declares void(*PE_arm_debug_panic_hook)(const char*), const in RELEASE and mutable in DEVELOPMENT. Native DEVELOPMENT already initializes this slot with PE_arm_panic_hook, authenticated with diversity 0x2abe; preserve that real handler and its chain bits, do not replace it with NULL. The native mutable DATA slot is preserved; no fabricated buffer is added.

32-bit int assertion-enable object with natural alignment >=4, read as a 32-bit flag at 81 IOHIDFamily ADRP/GOT use sites; cold targets terminate in BRK 0xbffc with MACH_ASSERT descriptors. Also imported by AppleT8142CLPC and ExclaveKextClient. osfmk/kern/assert.h mach_assert_enabled() under APPLE_KEXT_ASSERTIONS reads this int; osfmk/kern/debug.c declares int kext_assertions_enable=FALSE in RELEASE and TRUE in DEVELOPMENT. Original __common section is S_ZEROFILL (virtual zero, not missing file bytes); native __data holds integer 1, so native assertions remain enabled. Source identity establishes sizeof(int)=4; observed read footprint is 4, not the following linker padding.
